name: ABCfly_aircraft_bound_to_rc_or_gls_terms_content
texts:
"1. What does binding device do? 
Binding aircraft with the device controlling the aircraft (such as remote controller or goggles) records linking between aircraft and the device. If the aircraft is lost due to a flyaway incident, you can request to use DJI Care Flyaway Coverage. It is not possible to use DJI Care Flyaway Coverage if the aircraft is not bound with the remote controller. 
Note that: 
1) If aircraft is linked to multiple devices, the device directly linked to the app will be the binding device. 
2) Motion controller cannot be a binding device. 

2. What information is collected when a device is bound? 
Information collected during binding includes the information for the bound DJI account and the device hardware information for the bound aircraft and remote control device, which is used to record the binding status and support your use of DJI Care Flyaway Coverage. 

3. Can I change or unbind a bound device? 
After binding an aircraft with a device, you must use the bound device to control the aircraft. If you want to change or unbind the device, connect aircraft to app and change or unbind device in Device Management. You need to authorize DJI to use above info again after changing or unbinding device to make sure your aircraft remains valid for Flyaway Report. 

4. Can I use the aircraft without network connection after binding aircraft with the device? 
Some aircraft models need a network connection to verify the aircraft status after enabling the device binding function. To provide you with a better user experience when using this kind of aircraft, you can fly the aircraft without a network connection for a certain number of times until the app prompts you to connect to the network and verify the aircraft status. After verification, you can continue flying the aircraft without a network connection for a certain number of times. 

Contact DJI Support if you have further questions."

name: ABCfly_device_aircraft_flyaway_terms_content_v2
texts:
"1. What is DJI Care Flyaway Report? 
Submitting DJI Care Flyaway Report marks your aircraft as lost. Flight is prohibited once confirmed. This is required for enjoying DJI Care Flyaway Coverage. 

2. Can I cancel my submission after my report is confirmed? 
1) If you haven't already used your DJI Care Flyaway Coverage, you can contact DJI Support to cancel the submission and use the aircraft normally. 
2) If you have already used your DJI Care Flyaway Coverage, ownership of the lost aircraft is transferred to DJI, and you will be unable to cancel your submission. 

3. What information is required for the DJI Care Flyaway Report? 
Information includes the DJI account connected to the aircraft and the device hardware information for the bound aircraft, remote controller, or goggles. 

Contact DJI Support if you have further questions."

name: gdpr_product_improvement_data_smart_ability_content
texts: Intelligence data refers to image data from vision sensor and device information recorded by aircraft when aircraft initiates obstacle avoidance and automatic shooting functions, or when malfunctions and crashing occur. Intelligence data also includes environmental audio data in noise reduction and command modes. Such data will help us optimize algorithms and models, enhance flight safety, and provide better user experience. Before data analysis, photos and videos will be desensitized and anonymized first to protect your privacy.

name: gdpr_product_improvement_data_ua_device_info_content
texts: Includes aircraft bypassing and map data used to provide flight assistance, flight trajectory data when positioning accuracy is low, as well as lite logs including device, account, geographic location, and basic aircraft information that are generated in scenarios such as suspected malfunctions and crashes. Data is used to optimize flight assistance features and algorithms and improve flight safety and product experience. Before data analysis, location and device information will be desensitized and anonymized first to protect your privacy

name: homepage_utmiss_dialogue_content
texts:
"You are in Mainland China. According to the General Flight Rules of the People's Republic of China, the Regulations on the Control of General-Purpose Aviation Flight, and the Regulations on Real-time Flight Data for Light and Small Civilian UAVs, you are required to transmit flight data in real-time to the CAAC during flight. Ensure real-time flight data reporting is enabled for your aircraft.

Your flight data will be transmitted to UTMISS of the CAAC in real-time via network connection or will be cached to your local device if the network connection does not work. The data will not be saved or used by any services supported by DJI. To learn more about which data is reported, tap %1$s"

name: me_device_info_accessories_management_drone_dongle_apn_content
texts:
"Contact your network provider to configure APN settings. Incorrect APN settings may lead to loss of data connection. Generally, you do not require different APN settings if your previous settings work properly. Check the following if issue persists. 
1. Try to move to a location with a stronger signal 
2. Restart aircraft or remount DJI Cellular Dongle and try again 
3. Make sure SIM card service has sufficient balance and data allowance 
4. Switch to a different network provider and try again 
5. Make sure SIM card can connect to the internet and access 4G networks 
6. If issue persists after completing the above steps, try inserting SIM card on other mobile device with an internet connection. If the mobile device receives signal and has access to internet, contact DJI Support"

name: upgrade_connect_drone_guide_GLS79_start_mc_content
texts:
"Connect motion controller if you have and update together with goggles

1. Press motion controller power button once and then press and hold it again to power on motion controller

2. Make sure motion controller and goggles are connected and follow prompts in app to update devices"

name: upgrade_connect_drone_guide_connect_goggles_mc_success_next_btn

name: upgrade_connect_drone_guide_connect_mc_and_gls_content
texts:
"1. Make sure motion controller is powered on. Press power button and M button simultaneously and hold for 3s until it beeps to indicate that motion controller is ready for update

2. Tap button below, and goggles are ready for update

3. Check for firmware updates and update both devices to latest versions"

name: upgrade_connect_drone_guide_connect_mc_and_gls_gfsk_content
texts:
"1. Make sure motion controller is powered on. Press and hold motion controller power button for 3s until it beeps to indicate that it is ready for update

2. Tap button below, and goggles are ready for update

3. Check for firmware updates and update both devices to latest versions"

name: wifi_mode_connect_card_wifi_connect_fail_content_android
texts:
"1. Restart device and make sure device is within 1 m of mobile device
2. Disable and then enable Wi-Fi on mobile device or restart mobile device
3. In network list of mobile device, find device Wi-Fi and select to forget or delete this network
4. Make sure WLAN, WLAN Assistant, or wireless and networks is disabled in system settings (feature name varies by mobile device brands)
5. If connection still fails, go to system settings > Wi-Fi to manually connect to device, then try connecting again in app"

name: wifi_mode_connect_card_wifi_connect_fail_goggles_content_android
texts:
"1. Go to mobile device's system settings and make sure Wi-Fi Assistant is disabled

2. Go to mobile device's WLAN settings and connect to Wi-Fi network of goggles manually

Note: Your mobile device must be compatible with 5GHz Wi-Fi frequency to be able to connect to goggles via Wi-Fi"
